evidence: The root was 830 component positions after the initial 661-record rep_02 prefix and was not the first resumed component.
The 829 intervening newly reconstructed units preceding the root did not create a G3 failure.
Rep_03 was reconstructed later in the same recovered process and its root semantic state and check output exactly match rep_01.
The resume path applies the same frozen fitting function to missing rep_02 units and all rep_03 units; recovered records are skipped by identity and are not used as the root unit's fit input.
No incomplete transaction, object collision, journal inconsistency, persistence mismatch, or recovery-boundary adjacency exists for the root.
limitation: Component journals do not contain per-record timestamps; the root time is bounded by the recovery journal and supported by immutable object filesystem metadata. This does not establish a solver-internal mechanism.
causality_statement: Post-recovery timing alone is not treated as causal. Persisted ordering, controls, rep_03 behavior, and artifact integrity provide affirmative evidence against a recovery implementation artifact.
